target_customer: Small and midsize businesses and accounting firms that need bookkeeping, reconciliation and tax filing
problem: Small businesses find accounting slow and expensive. Minerva offers an AI accountant that automates bookkeeping, reconciliation and tax filing, sitting on top of existing ledgers.
business_model: Tech enabled accounting service, subscription pricing (exact pricing not found)

founders.name: Peter Zhu
education: Brown University, math and computer science
founders.background_notes: From Canada per the YC page. Prior employers not listed.

founders.name: Om Agarwal
founders.background_notes: From Canada per the YC page; the founders met at an international science fair in high school.

competitors.name: Pilot
competitors.what: Bookkeeping that combines software with human accountants
competitors.traction_then: established; plans from about $169 per month in 2025

competitors.name: Digits
competitors.what: AI native accounting platform with an autonomous general ledger

competitors.name: Zeni
competitors.what: AI bookkeeping and finance for tech startups

technical_complexity.rationale: Accurate automated bookkeeping and tax filing needs ledger integrations and reliable model outputs with accountant review, harder than a wrapper but built on existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Books and filings create some lock-in and licensed accountants matter, but many AI accounting rivals competed from 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded rivals such as Rillet, Basis and Digits kept building AI accounting; no acquisition of Minerva reported.

market_need_then: Small business accounting is costly and slow; the company claimed accountants would be largely replaced within about a decade (May 2025 coverage). Independent demand data not collected.

branding.domain_note: Company site is joinminerva.ai and contact domain tryminerva.ai, so no exact .com.

identity.logo: Minerva wordmark with a colonnade image on the site
identity.visual_style: Not assessed beyond the wordmark and classical imagery
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and mission driven, short direct statements

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated companies use the Minerva name, including a $20M marketing platform launched in 2026, and no brand specific press was found.

outcome_analysis: Minerva is an active five person YC Spring 2025 company still hiring a financial controller. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found. It competes against well funded AI accounting players, and its funding is unclear, so there is not enough evidence to call the outcome either way.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: VCBacked lists a $525K pre-seed in 2025-04, a June 2025 digest says a $2M seed was three quarters complete, Caplight lists a seed dated 2025-05 with no amount. Peter Zhu's YC bio names Amino Capital and Goodwater Capital as backers but no terms were found. A different Minerva raised $20M in 2026 and must not be mixed in. Stage of the company's own round is not stated by a primary source. Round update: the 525K pre-seed (2025-04) is recorded from a single database (VCBacked). The 2M seed reported as three quarters complete in a June 2025 digest was not closed per any source and is not recorded; a gap of unknown size may remain.
